verdict.rationale: ernd is a corporate card and rewards service with an app, so a privacy control for opting out of usage tracking or data collection is a fair question for this kind of product. The evidence pack covers only rewards rates, partner perks, card requests and redemption. Nothing documents a telemetry, analytics or usage-tracking opt-out. The 'withdraw it from the app' line refers to money or points, not data collection.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can opt out of telemetry and usage tracking
